scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all-rank covering radius, exhaustive hole orbits, tangent-polar volume and leading angular/Haar tail. Finite independent numerical cross-checks support but do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed N,k endpoint asymptotic, not an all-radius distribution or uniform-in-dimension estimate; unindexed priority remains a risk.
title: Sharp spherical deep-hole tails for Johnson hypersimplex codes
